Subject: Dedicated capacity sizing call — next steps

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the right folks aligned for a dedicated capacity sizing session: 

Recap (high-level):
- Primary use case: conversational customer support + nightly batch reranking for re-ranks.
- Current traffic profile you mentioned: ~150 QPS steady-state during business hours, spikes up to ~700 QPS during peak events.
- Target latency: p95 < 300ms for short prompts (~50 tokens), p99 < 800ms for longer prompts.
- Data residency: US-only for inference logging; model weights can be hosted in our managed infra.

Goal for the sizing call:
- Walk through throughput targets, sequence length distributions, and target latency SLOs.
- Surface recommended instance types, batching and caching strategies, and an initial capacity estimate (dedicated GPU pools).

Proposed times (PT):
- Tue Dec 1 — 10:00–10:45 or 13:00–13:45 PT
- Wed Dec 2 — 09:00–09:45 PT

Suggested attendees:
- Your side: infra/ML engineering lead (to confirm traffic and security), procurement (if you want contract/ops questions answered live)
- Our side: Mateo (runtime engineer), Vivek (solutions architect), me (AE)

I attached a short capacity questionnaire to speed the prep (capacity_questionnaire.xlsx). If you can share a quick traffic snapshot (QPS by endpoint, avg prompt length, peak concurrency) ahead of the call that would be ideal.

Can you confirm which time works and who will join? Happy to send a calendar invite once we lock a slot.

Best,

Marissa Cole
